description: This file defines a test class 'TestAzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler' that extends 'AzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler'. It provides methods for creating failure handlers and retrieving delivery failure counts, specific to handling stream failures using Azure Table Storage in a testing context.

classes.name: TestAzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: A test handler class for managing stream failure records in Azure Table Storage, used within testing scenarios.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes an instance of the failure handler asynchronously.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of delivery failure entries for a specified stream provider.

methods.name: GetDataManager
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AzureTableDataManager configured for the appropriate table.

methods.name: GetAzureStorageOperationOptions
methods.description: Provides configuration options for Azure Storage operations, setting the table name.

methods.name: GetStreamingAzureStorageOperationOptions
methods.description: Provides Azure Storage operation options specifically for streaming scenarios.
